extraction_notes: Exact target identity is 2SC1623（L6） from Guangdong Hottech. The PDF title is 2SC1623 and the L6 bin is identified on p. 1 by the hFE classification range 200-400.

The p. 1 electrical table is generic 2SC1623 data: hFE is 90 min, 200 typ, 600 max at VCE = 6 V and IC = 1 mA. The extracted scalar hFE uses the stated typical value, while the L6 range is preserved in its conditions.
Typical curves on p. 2 were digitized only at visible plotted locations; no points were interpolated. Curve axes and logarithmic or linear scaling follow the printed plots.

The p. 2 output characteristic, hFE, VBE, VCE(sat), fT, and Cob/Cib plots are available. The hFE, VBE, VCE(sat), fT, and capacitance curves are included above; the output plot is represented by one visible IB curve.

Additional p. 1 maximum ratings not represented by the strict schema are VCBO = 60 V, VEBO = 5 V, IC = 100 mA, PC = 200 mW, TJ = 150 degC, and RthetaJA = 625 degC/W at TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
No datasheet revision identifier is printed.
